title: Use responseFormat: 'json' hint at JSON-only ModelClient call sites
description: The 0jq.11 ModelClient contract introduced a provider-neutral responseFormat hint, but no call site uses it yet. The campaign-bible extractor is the one JSON-only site in core today (system prompt explicitly demands a fenced JSON block). Pass responseFormat: 'json' there so future adapters with a native JSON-mode can opt in, and harden the parser to also accept raw JSON (no fence) so a JSON-mode adapter that strips wrappers does not break the call site.
